name: Rainy Neon
rationale: Large side-weighted landmarks now survive both preview dimming and LMS cards: a heavy window edge and sill, three building masses with broad lit windows, a blank framed magenta sign, and a hard wet-street horizon with reflections tied to those lights. The stronger cyan and magenta background accents remain behind 88%-opaque navy surfaces, preserving all six palette contrast pairs.
motionNotes: Three thick foreground drops slide on separate 55-83 second paths, the distant and midground city layers drift by only a few pixels at different rates, and the blank sign breathes gently. A faint cloud-and-skyline reveal lasts under one second in each 29-second cycle. Architecture, the street horizon, window frame, and fixed glass beads remain stable anchors.
